New shared albums keep newly added photos and videos at original resolution. The owner provides iCloud storage. Depending on their role, participants can contribute or help manage the album, and the owner can invite people with a link.

Legacy shared albums use separate shared copies. Photos and videos may have lower resolution than the originals, and they do not use the owner’s iCloud storage quota. The owner decides whether subscribers can add photos.
A shared copy is separate from your personal library. Saving it to your phone does not verify a backup of the original.
Upgrading affects newly shared items; it does not restore detail lost in older shared copies. Existing albums are never upgraded automatically.

Alba brings your iCloud photos to Android 11 and later. It is experimental software: features may break as Apple changes its services. Alba is independent of Apple.

Your phone connects directly to Apple. Alba has no server for your photos or credentials, does not save your password, and has no ads or behavioral analytics. Saved sessions are encrypted on this phone.
Diagnostic reporting is not configured in this build. No diagnostic data is sent.
Send anonymous crash and performance information to Sentry. This never includes photos, filenames, Apple Account details or credentials.
